description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from rodent brain-slice electrophysiology experiments using pharmacological manipulation and patch-clamp recordings to study neurotransmitter receptor effects on synaptic plasticity and causal interactions.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or experimental observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study, project, or manuscript.

experiment_date.descr: Date the experiment was performed, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

species.descr: Rodent species used in the preparation, e.g., mouse, rat.

strain.descr: Animal strain or line, e.g., C57BL/6J, Sprague-Dawley.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the animal, e.g., male, female, mixed, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the animal in days at the time of slice preparation or recording.

body_weight_g.descr: Body weight of the animal in grams, if available.

brain_region.descr: Brain region from which the slice was prepared, e.g., hippocampus, cortex, striatum.

subregion.descr: More specific anatomical subdivision, e.g., CA1, dentate gyrus, layer 2/3.

slice_type.descr: Slice preparation type, e.g., acute brain slice, organotypic slice.

slice_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the brain slice in micrometers.

species_source.descr: Source of the animals, e.g., vendor or breeding colony.

anesthesia_or_euthanasia_method.descr: Method used for anesthesia or euthanasia prior to tissue collection.

recording_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during recording in degrees Celsius.

external_solution_composition.descr: Composition of the extracellular bath solution used during recording, as a free-text formulation or standardized description.

internal_solution_composition.descr: Composition of the pipette/internal solution used for patch clamp, as a free-text formulation or standardized description.

patch_clamp_configuration.descr: Patch-clamp mode used, e.g., whole-cell, cell-attached, voltage-clamp, current-clamp.

cell_type.descr: Recorded cell type or neuronal class, if known, e.g., pyramidal neuron, interneuron.

membrane_potential_mV.descr: Holding or resting membrane potential in millivolts, if applicable.

holding_current_pA.descr: Holding current in picoamperes, if applicable.

stimulation_protocol.descr: Electrical or optogenetic stimulation paradigm used to evoke synaptic responses, if any.

synaptic_response_type.descr: Type of synaptic response measured, e.g., EPSC, IPSC, EPSP, paired-pulse ratio.

plasticity_measurement.descr: Primary plasticity endpoint, e.g., LTP, LTD, short-term facilitation, release probability.

response_amplitude_change_pct.descr: Percent change in synaptic response amplitude relative to baseline or control.

baseline_amplitude.descr: Baseline synaptic response amplitude in appropriate units, if reported.

response_amplitude_units.descr: Units for synaptic response amplitude, e.g., pA, mV.

neurotransmitter_system.descr: Neurotransmitter system investigated, e.g., glutamatergic, GABAergic, cholinergic, dopaminergic, serotonergic.

receptor_target.descr: Specific neurotransmitter receptor targeted or implicated, e.g., NMDA receptor, AMPA receptor, GABAA receptor, D1 receptor.

receptor_subunit.descr: Receptor subunit or isoform when relevant, e.g., GluN2B, GABAA alpha1.

pharmacological_agent_name.descr: Name of the drug, agonist, antagonist, modulator, or inhibitor used.

pharmacological_agent_class.descr: Drug class or mechanism, e.g., antagonist, agonist, positive allosteric modulator.

drug_target.descr: Primary molecular target of the pharmacological agent.

drug_concentration_uM.descr: Concentration of the pharmacological agent in micromolar.

drug_application_route.descr: How the agent was applied, e.g., bath perfusion, local puff, intracellular.

drug_application_duration_min.descr: Duration of pharmacological application in minutes.

washin_time_min.descr: Time from drug start to observed effect onset, if measured, in minutes.

washout_performed.descr: Whether the pharmacological agent was washed out after application.

causal_interaction_identified.descr: Whether the record supports a causal interaction between receptor activity and synaptic plasticity.

causal_direction.descr: Direction of the causal effect, e.g., receptor activation increases plasticity, receptor blockade prevents LTD.

causal_relation_type.descr: Type of causal relation inferred, e.g., necessary, sufficient, modulatory, inhibitory, facilitatory.

mechanistic_interpretation.descr: Short interpretive statement of the inferred mechanism linking neurotransmitter receptors to synaptic plasticity.

effect_size.descr: Quantitative measure of causal or treatment effect, if available.

effect_size_metric.descr: Metric used for effect size, e.g., Cohen's d, odds ratio, fold-change.

statistical_significance_p.descr: Reported p-value for the main effect or causal comparison.

sample_size_n.descr: Number of recorded cells or biological replicates in this record.

animal_count_n.descr: Number of animals contributing to this record, if distinct from sample size.

control_condition.descr: Description of the control condition used for comparison.

comparison_group.descr: Description of the experimental or treatment group compared to control.

published_study_title.descr: Title of the published study supporting or contextualizing the findings.

published_study_authors.descr: First author and/or author list for the supporting published study.

published_study_year.descr: Year of publication of the supporting study.

journal_name.descr: Name of the journal where the study was published.

doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier for the supporting publication, if available.

pmid.descr: PubMed ID for the supporting publication, if available.

citation_text.descr: Full citation in a standard format for the supporting study.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes about unusual conditions, limitations, or interpretation.
